title: The Fall of Zedekiah and the Destruction of Jerusalem
description: After a long siege, Nebuchadnezzar's army breaks through Jerusalem's walls. King Zedekiah flees at night, but the Chaldeans catch him on the plains of Jericho. He is taken to Riblah, where his sons and the nobles of Judah are slaughtered before his eyes. Then he is blinded and led in chains to Babylon, while the city is burned and its walls torn down.
